mutations.contract: A loopback page in a browser WITH File System Access asks for the FOLDER and says nothing about the API. The check read `/Connect folder|File System Access/` until 2026-09-22 and was satisfied by either state, so it was a claim about neither.
mutations.note: The source issue proposed witnessing this by mutating the ENVIRONMENT (deleting window.showDirectoryPicker before the goto), which this table cannot express -- it patches files in the shadow tree, not the browser. It does not need to: the guard's subject is the COPY, so making the pre-grant banner name the API is the defect, and it is exactly the one the retired disjunction would have accepted. Its twin `flyout-pre-grant-banner-asks-for-the-folder` declares the same mutation against the embedded surface's own suite.
